features.title: Sharpshooter
features.text: High firearm and crossbow accuracy rewards carefully set-up shots. Reloading is part of your combat rhythm, and some builds focus on helping allies land their attacks.

features.title: Ways and deeds
features.text: Your way combines reloads with movement, skill actions or other tricks. Choose equipment and feats that work with that routine.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 4 → 3.5–4.5. Accurate shots and critical hits are strong, but reload costs and weapon choices affect sustained damage.
ratings.defense: 3 → 3. Medium armor and defensive progression give solid martial resilience.
ratings.support: 3 → 2–4. Reload tricks, Aid options and way choices can favor team support over personal attacks.
ratings.utility: 2 → 2. Perception and selected skills help scouting; few broad noncombat class features.
ratings.difficulty: 2.5 → 3. Coordinate reload actions, positioning and shot selection.
